metadata.title: Urban Luxury Portrait with Distressed Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium shot of a man in a vibrant green and blue tweed jacket sitting in an ornate armchair. The background is a desaturated, high-contrast classical interior with a fireplace and mantle. The top right quadrant is dominated by large, distressed yellow custom lettering that interlocks with secondary white sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Rough, distressed text texture vs. smooth photographic skin tones
Diagonal lean of the subject vs. vertical architectural lines
High-saturation green jacket as the primary focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower left and center, scaled to feel imposing and close to the lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant green jacket acts as the primary anchor, while the large yellow text block serves as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down the bright jacket, then sweeps up to the large yellow title in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, moody space in the upper left and bottom center provides breathing room for the busy textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale/sepia for the background environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-saturation emerald green and cyan for the subject's jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard yellow for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the background; high saturation contrast between the subject and the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Keep background tones muted and cold

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed slab serif and sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges and internal grit texture
Spurred serifs on the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'R' and 'O' in the bottom row of the title
Smaller scale 'Mr.' and 'the' tucked into the negative space of larger letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact textured slab serif paired with a clean, legible condensed sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Subtle outer glow on white text

avoid: Bright primary colors other than yellow

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and bold presence.
Captures the spurred serif and rugged feel of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle portrait of a man with dark sunglasses and a textured green/blue tweed jacket, sitting in a dark ornate chair. The background is a desaturated, high-contrast classical room with a fireplace, rendered in cool grays and blacks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, mustard-yellow distressed slab-serif text in the top right, stacked in two rows with interlocking letters. Below it, add a clean white condensed sans-serif name.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket texture clearly visible?
Does the yellow text have a heavy, eroded texture?
Is the camera angle low, looking up at the subject?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or advisory labels
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is the brightest element besides the jacket.
Check that the background doesn't compete with the subject's saturation.
Verify the 'gritty' feel of the typography edges.
Confirm the low-angle perspective creates a sense of dominance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation textured subject with a desaturated classical background and heavy, distressed, condensed typography in a contrasting warm color.
